title: JOHN / THE STAGED DISAPPEARANCE
clarification: DETECTIVE: Before I reconstruct this: did you only help with preparations, or did you actually see John leave the aircraft?
ALEX: I saw him leave the aircraft and his parachute open before impact. What I said earlier about the crash ending everything was the cover story. I did not follow him to his destination.

evidence.title: Alex's admission / equipment accounting
evidence.text: Alex admits helping John prepare his disappearance. The equipment issue includes one parachute; the later recovery accounting does not account for it. Preparations precede the flight.

evidence.title: JM-041 / transport record
evidence.text: The aircraft was transporting the recovered artifact. Departure precedes both the witnessed exit and the crash.

evidence.title: Alex's clarification
evidence.text: Alex states he saw John leave the aircraft and the parachute open before impact. This is the witness basis for the exit event; the missing equipment entry alone would not establish a jump.

evidence.title: JM-041-R / later recovery
evidence.text: The wreckage was located after the crash. Neither John's body nor the artifact was recovered. No identification of John's body or recovery of the artifact is documented here.

evidence.title: Limits of Alex's account
evidence.text: Alex does not know John's destination. His account supports an escape before impact, not a current address or a guarantee about John's present circumstances.

conclusions.label: STAGED ESCAPE
conclusions.explanation: The preparations, witness account and recovery record support an escape before impact.

conclusions.label: DEATH CONFIRMED
conclusions.explanation: No body was identified, and Alex places John outside the aircraft before impact.

conclusions.label: LOCATION KNOWN
conclusions.explanation: Alex explicitly says he does not know John's destination.

success: John arranged an escape before the crash and used the crash as cover for his disappearance. The reconstruction does not locate him or identify whoever was responsible for every act of sabotage.
